🍎 APPLE INDIA CROSSES ₹1 LAKH CRORE IN REVENUE — A RECORD FY26!

Apple’s India business has crossed a major financial milestone. Its revenue increased by 32% to ₹1,04,607 crore in FY26, compared with ₹79,060.5 crore in FY25, according to figures shared by market intelligence firm Tofler.

📊 Key financial highlights:

• Revenue: ₹1,04,607 crore (+32%)
• Net profit: ₹5,311 crore (+66%)
• Total expenses: ₹96,224 crore

The growth reflects Apple's expanding business in India, supported by demand for premium smartphones and its growing retail presence.

💡 Why does this matter?

India is becoming an increasingly important market for global technology companies. Crossing the ₹1 lakh crore revenue mark highlights the scale of Apple's business in the country and the growing purchasing power of Indian consumers.

The bigger question: Can Apple maintain this momentum in the coming years?

💬 What do you think is driving Apple's growth in India — brand value, product quality, or the rising demand for premium smartphones?

📰 Sources: Tofler data, Press Trust of India (PTI), Business Standard — 23 October 2026.

17901069348612210.headline: 🌫️ “I’M HONESTLY SURPRISED WE’RE STILL ALIVE” — AIIMS DOCTOR
17901069348612210.caption:
🌫️ “I’M HONESTLY SURPRISED WE’RE STILL ALIVE” — AIIMS DOCTOR WARNS ABOUT DELHI’S TOXIC AIR

Delhi’s post-Diwali air pollution has triggered serious concern among medical experts. Dr Vijay Hadda, Professor of Pulmonary Medicine at AIIMS Delhi, has warned that prolonged exposure to the city’s polluted air poses a significant risk to public health.

Speaking about the worsening conditions, Dr Hadda said he was surprised people were still managing to live with such air quality. He also highlighted that even otherwise healthy people were reporting persistent throat irritation and respiratory discomfort.

📊 How bad is the pollution?

• On November 9, Delhi recorded an AQI of 370, in the Very Poor category.
• Several neighbourhoods crossed the 400 mark, entering the Severe category.
• On November 11, the citywide AQI improved to 299, but several monitoring stations continued to report Very Poor air.

⚠️ Why does this matter?

Air pollution is not just a seasonal inconvenience. Prolonged exposure to particulate matter can worsen asthma and other respiratory conditions and increase cardiovascular risks. Children, older people and those with existing health conditions are particularly vulnerable.

Dr Hadda also pointed out that green crackers do not eliminate pollution: they reduce emissions by only around 30%, according to his remarks.

💬 Should tackling air pollution become a year-round public health priority rather than an annual emergency response?

📰 Sources: Reuters (9 November 2026); ANI / The Economic Times (9 November 2026); Mid-Day / PTI (11 November 2026).

18133806745743982.caption:
💔 FROM IIT M.TECH TO A ₹26 LPA PACKAGE — AND THEN A LAYOFF AT QUALCOMM

A viral social media post has sparked conversations about job security in India's technology sector.

The post describes an IIT Hyderabad M.Tech graduate who reportedly cleared GATE, secured a placement at Qualcomm with an annual CTC of over ₹26 lakh, and was subsequently affected by the company's layoffs.

While the individual's story has not been independently verified, the broader layoffs at Qualcomm are real.

📉 What's happening at Qualcomm India?

• Layoffs reportedly began at the Bengaluru facility on 9 November 2026.
• Around 1,000 Indian jobs are estimated to be at risk.
• Qualcomm has approximately 20,000 employees in India.
• Engineering and R&D operations in Hyderabad, Chennai and Delhi-NCR may also be affected.

The company has not officially confirmed the final number of Indian job cuts.

🎓 Why does this matter to students?

For engineering students preparing for GATE, pursuing M.Tech degrees and targeting high-paying technology jobs, this development raises an important question:

Does a prestigious degree and a high salary guarantee career security anymore?

A strong career requires more than a college tag or an impressive package. Continuous learning, adaptability and financial planning matter too.

💬 What do you think? Is job security disappearing even in top technology companies?

A brief exchange on X between Elon Musk and financial account ZeroHedge caught the tech world’s attention.

After ZeroHedge posted, “Elon please hire Jensen,” Musk replied: “That would be an honor.”

The comment came amid growing uncertainty around Jensen Huang’s position at Nvidia. Huang subsequently resigned as CEO on November 12, 2026, and Nvidia CFO Colette Kress was named interim chief executive.

18343812298260920.caption:
🕊️ IIT ROORKEE STUDENT FOUND DEAD IN HOSTEL ROOM; POLICE INVESTIGATION UNDERWAY

A tragic incident has been reported at the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Roorkee.

Ayush Rajoria, a 20-year-old second-year student enrolled in the BS-MS Programme in Mathematics and Computing, was found dead in his hostel room on Thursday evening, November 12.

According to reports, suicide is suspected. However, the circumstances surrounding his death are under investigation by the police.

The institute has expressed grief over the incident and stated that it is cooperating with the authorities and extending support to the bereaved family.

🕯️ A reminder for the campus community: Student well-being, emotional support and accessible mental-health resources deserve continued attention. No student should feel alone while navigating difficult times.

Our heartfelt condolences to Ayush's family, friends and the IIT Roorkee community. May they find strength during this difficult time.

Please respect the family's privacy and avoid spreading unverified claims.

18109979474249405.headline: NEARLY 550 INNODATA EMPLOYEES REPORTEDLY LAID OFF IN INDIA
18109979474249405.caption:
🚨 NEARLY 550 INNODATA EMPLOYEES REPORTEDLY LAID OFF IN INDIA

A sudden workforce reduction at US-based AI services company Innodata has reportedly affected nearly 550 employees in India, with job cuts also reported in the Philippines.

According to media reports, the layoffs took place on 26 October 2026. Several employees said they began their day as usual, logged in and marked attendance, but later found themselves locked out of company laptops, official IDs and internal systems.

📌 What happened?

🔹 Nearly 550 employees in India were reportedly affected.

🔹 Employees said access to company devices and accounts was withdrawn during the workday.

🔹 Termination emails were subsequently sent to personal email addresses.

🔹 The communication reportedly cited a reduction in business assignments and operational requirements, rather than individual performance.

🔹 Job cuts were also reported among teams in the Philippines.

⚠️ Important clarification: Innodata has not publicly confirmed the reported total number of affected employees or issued a detailed public explanation.

💡 Why it matters

The incident raises serious questions about job security, transparent communication and employee support during sudden layoffs. For workers, losing access to employment records and payroll systems can make an already difficult situation even more stressful.

As AI-related businesses continue to evolve, employees also need fair communication and responsible workforce-transition practices.

📰 Sources: India Today, LiveMint, NDTV and Business Today.

📅 Reports published: 27–28 October 2026

18037042322906535.headline: 🚀 FROM CFO TO INTERIM CEO: MEET THE WOMAN NOW LEADING NVIDIA!
18037042322906535.caption:
🚀 FROM CFO TO INTERIM CEO: MEET THE WOMAN NOW LEADING NVIDIA!

Colette Kress has stepped into one of the biggest leadership roles in the technology industry after being appointed interim CEO of NVIDIA on November 12, 2026, following Jensen Huang’s resignation.

Her journey at NVIDIA began in September 2013, when she joined as Executive Vice President and CFO. At the time, the company generated approximately $4.13 billion in annual revenue. By FY2026, NVIDIA’s revenue had reached $215.9 billion.

Kress will continue serving as CFO while leading the company on an interim basis as its board searches for a permanent CEO.

💡 Why it matters: Her appointment marks a major leadership transition at a company central to the global AI revolution. Her financial experience and understanding of NVIDIA’s growth will be crucial during this period.

A remarkable career journey — from managing the numbers to leading the entire company.
